participants.PARTICIPANT_CLASS: approved PostgreSQL18 engine plus TEST login bridge

PRINCIPAL_ID.subject_binding: Exact unique slot UID/retained process birth and enrollment identity

participants.OWNER_ID: No inspected database/schema/table/function ownership; engine OS owns only private TEST PGDATA, not native registry or other slot material

AUTHORITY_SCOPE.LOGIN_OR_NONLOGIN_REQUIREMENT: No native SQL login credential; reader proxy has separate explicit LOGIN role
AUTHORITY_SCOPE.ROLE_MEMBERSHIP_REQUIREMENT: Zero incoming/outgoing SQL owner/admin/shared-role memberships; no native OS supplementary privilege groups
AUTHORITY_SCOPE.INHERIT_POLICY: DENY authority inheritance; process forks only as declared engine children, never key inheritance
AUTHORITY_SCOPE.OWNERSHIP_POLICY: No inspected database/schema/table/function ownership; engine OS owns only private TEST PGDATA, not native registry or other slot material
AUTHORITY_SCOPE.SUPERUSER_POLICY: NO SQL superuser credential or operational root broker
AUTHORITY_SCOPE.PUBLIC_DEPENDENCY_POLICY: No authority inferred from PUBLIC; snapshot must classify every applicable public grant separately
AUTHORITY_SCOPE.DEFAULT_PRIVILEGE_DEPENDENCY_POLICY: No implicit non-owner new-object privilege; require approved creator/default snapshot
AUTHORITY_SCOPE.SECURITY_DEFINER_DEPENDENCY_POLICY: Native snapshot reader INVOKER/read-only only; no privileged definer fallback without independently closed exception
AUTHORITY_SCOPE.OBSERVATION_AUTHORITY: Role-specific signed facts; cannot self-issue independent observer truth
AUTHORITY_SCOPE.CROSS_PARTICIPANT_AUTHORITY_RULE: No access to other slot private key/process memory/write endpoint; all peer facts independently revalidated by HEALTH_GUARD

EXECUTION_SCOPE.EXECUTION_BOUNDARY: private TEST user/PID/mount/time/IPC/cgroup compartment, exact HOST-approved labels and immutable executable
EXECUTION_SCOPE.ALLOWED_PARENT_IDENTITY_RULE: Exact retained birth tuple from preserved native identity codec; no PID/name-only match
EXECUTION_SCOPE.PROCESS_IDENTITY_RULE: preserved native-identity-codec process_instance_identity + current registry entity
EXECUTION_SCOPE.BINARY_IDENTITY_RULE: full approved executable bytes SHA256, FUTURE_MEASURED
EXECUTION_SCOPE.MODULE_IDENTITY_RULE: exact approved module map/hash; FUTURE_MEASURED never source hash substitution
EXECUTION_SCOPE.LOADER_IDENTITY_RULE: approved ELF interpreter+fixed resolution manifest; no ambient ENV
EXECUTION_SCOPE.DEPENDENCY_IDENTITY_RULE: closed flat node/edge manifest, exact approved file handles
EXECUTION_SCOPE.CHILD_CREATION_POLICY: SUPERVISOR fixed seven-slot pre-enrollment plan only; after sealing no clone/fork/exec. POSTMASTER only owned engine children under ACTIVE rule table and HOST observed birth inventory; unknown process class quarantines
EXECUTION_SCOPE.SIBLING_COMMUNICATION_POLICY: Native participants communicate only via exact HEALTH_GUARD typed channels; readonly artifact/journal sharing is not an unmediated sibling RPC
EXECUTION_SCOPE.INHERITED_HANDLE_POLICY: Only signed bootstrap inventory, no unknown descriptor; receive current SCM_PIDFD as temporary validation handle and close it; reject all unsolicited SCM_RIGHTS

INHERITED_DESCRIPTOR_POLICY.fd4: private key import PRE_ENROLLMENT then closed and forbidden for data IO
INHERITED_DESCRIPTOR_POLICY.temporary_fds: fstat/close only, never replace protected fd or label

EXECUTION_SCOPE.INHERITED_ENVIRONMENT_POLICY: Empty environment except explicit immutable locale/loader and exact descriptor-role map approved in build manifest; no PATH/PYTHONPATH/LD_PRELOAD/LD_LIBRARY_PATH import fallback
EXECUTION_SCOPE.INHERITED_CREDENTIAL_POLICY: Fresh slot/purpose/generation key only; no inherited host/admin/provider/domain key or DB superuser password
EXECUTION_SCOPE.DYNAMIC_CODE_LOADING_POLICY: All code/provider mappings preloaded/hash-verified during trusted initialization; ACTIVE denies executable new mappings/dlopen targets; unsupported required dependency denies activation
EXECUTION_SCOPE.ARBITRARY_COMMAND_POLICY: DENY exec/shell/SQL API in native messages
EXECUTION_SCOPE.NETWORK_POLICY: No AF_INET/AF_INET6/external DNS; exact inherited AF_UNIX channels. POSTMASTER private TEST listener only; observer SQL transport held by dedicated fixed reader proxy, never exported to participants
EXECUTION_SCOPE.FILESYSTEM_POLICY: No host/prod/private-other-slot mount. Code/config/public originals RO; private key sealed memory; native journal participants RO. POSTMASTER PGDATA private engine storage write is explicit service exception, never native caller-selected file authority
EXECUTION_SCOPE.DATABASE_CONNECTION_POLICY: OS-only participants hold no SQL credential/session. POSTMASTER owns private TEST server only. Receiver/census request typed fixed observation from private READ_PROXY; no participant has arbitrary SQL transport
EXECUTION_SCOPE.RESTART_POLICY: No bootstrap authority returns inside ACTIVE; retire old generation, reconcile UNKNOWN, prove old endpoints extinct, then explicit fresh bootstrap/new generation
EXECUTION_SCOPE.RECONNECT_POLICY: Retain pending UNKNOWN; no new enrolled channel or inherited credential while unresolved
EXECUTION_SCOPE.postmaster_exception_necessity: A database engine must manage its own private storage/children to perform source-mandated catalog probes; read-only OS process cannot start it. This grants no SQL superuser/login credential or arbitrary command to a native participant caller

participants.CREDENTIAL_CLASS: Authenticated private TEST server-endpoint identity; distinct observer keys sign probe witnesses, never impersonate postmaster

CUSTODY_SCOPE.CUSTODIAN: HOST-held expected server endpoint authentication manifest, no fabricated POSTMASTER message key
CUSTODY_SCOPE.DELIVERY_CHANNEL: Dedicated inherited sealed FD4 or server-endpoint expected manifest for POSTMASTER
CUSTODY_SCOPE.DELIVERY_AUTHENTICATION: Exact retained parent/child birth and immutable bootstrap inventory
CUSTODY_SCOPE.STORAGE_POLICY: Private slot UID only, sealed memfd, no host paths/env/argv/log export
CUSTODY_SCOPE.MEMORY_RESIDENCE_POLICY: Import before ACTIVE, non-dumpable private memory, no ptrace/proc access; fixed bounded buffers zeroized after retirement
CUSTODY_SCOPE.PERSISTENCE_POLICY: No private key disk persistence; public SPKI/digest/tombstone only
CUSTODY_SCOPE.USE_COUNT: One accepted work authorization; duplicate returns same receipt. Separate heartbeat purpose has finite approved frame count
CUSTODY_SCOPE.EXPIRY_RULE: Exact immutable native policy BOOTTIME bound and current boot/timens; current generation/enrollment mandatory, no TTL renewal
CUSTODY_SCOPE.GENERATION_BINDING: Exact current slot/generation high-water, no fallback
CUSTODY_SCOPE.REVOCATION_AUTHORITY: NATIVE_REGISTRY_WRITER applies exact invalidation; HOST controls custody teardown
CUSTODY_SCOPE.CRASH_BEHAVIOR: UNKNOWN, no reissue of same live authority
CUSTODY_SCOPE.RESTART_BEHAVIOR: New generation/key only after old reconciliation/extinction/tombstone
CUSTODY_SCOPE.LEAK_OR_THEFT_BEHAVIOR: Quarantine entire affected generation; retire key/channel; stolen bytes alone cannot match required current kernel sender anchor
CUSTODY_SCOPE.REPLAY_BEHAVIOR: Deny used challenge/stale generation/context; identical terminal receipt read only
CUSTODY_SCOPE.DESTRUCTION_OR_ZEROIZATION_REQUIREMENT: Close import descriptor, explicit secret buffer cleanse on retirement; absence of destruction witness UNKNOWN

participants.GENERATION_SCOPE: Monotonic current entity + irreversible high-water/tombstone, no replacement on unknown lineage
participants.REVOCATION_SCOPE: Current generation invalidation + registry tombstone + key/channel ineligibility; no automatic production/recovery authority

FIXED_CALLABLE_SURFACE.EXPECTED_FUNCTION: Successful server-derived generation/catalog probe, as canonical native-proof-v6 PROGRESS_SOURCE requires
FIXED_CALLABLE_SURFACE.INPUT_CONTEXT: Expected immutable full header/role/database/postmaster generation and exact read projection digest
FIXED_CALLABLE_SURFACE.EXPECTED_RESULT_CLASS: Exact consistent generation/catalog snapshot digest + both independently authenticated observation receipts
FIXED_CALLABLE_SURFACE.RESULT_BINDING: Full ABI tuple + challenge/input/result/previous-state digests and exact generation/entity revisions
FIXED_CALLABLE_SURFACE.RESULT_WITNESS: Two distinct authenticated read-only native catalog observers obtain matching exact server-start/database/role/header snapshots, bind independent backend birth anchors from TEST login bridge and retained expected postmaster anchor, and check generation registry revision unchanged before/after. A generic backend SELECT or nonce alone is insufficient
FIXED_CALLABLE_SURFACE.INDEPENDENT_OBSERVER: HEALTH_GUARD, with role-specific distinct witness as stated
FIXED_CALLABLE_SURFACE.ONE_USE_PUBLICATION: Native completed-work entity CAS for this work_id, never generation-registry reset
FIXED_CALLABLE_SURFACE.REPLAY_REJECTION: Same original receipt only; no new work, renewed clock or changed revision
FIXED_CALLABLE_SURFACE.FAILURE_RESULT: REJECTED; deny native guard and latch quarantine when required
FIXED_CALLABLE_SURFACE.UNKNOWN_RESULT: Durable UNKNOWN, no approval/enforcement eligibility or replacement
